conditions.prompt: A sculpture depicts a graceful woman draped in flowing fabric, leaning gently against a slender column on a rectangular base, holding a cluster of sculpted flowers near her chest. The sculpture is set against a plain, solid white background, creating an isolated presentation. The lighting is bright and even, casting subtle shadows that define the contours of the form without harsh contrasts, captured at eye-level with clean clarity, neoclassical art, carved stone, textured drapery

A sculpture depicts a central woman with children carved from smooth, pale white marble, set inside a curved alcove with plain plaster walls.
